notes.title: We're Very Sorry... A Launch Delay Announcement for Dino Ramen Express
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We're two little dinos from the Dino Ramen Express dev team.

First of all, we want to sincerely apologize.
We previously promised to launch Dino Ramen Express on July 28, but due to an unexpected technical issue, we will no longer be able to meet that date.

Just as we were preparing for the final release build, we encountered a critical issue—
[b]a serious and irreversible package corruption occurred, resulting in the loss of some key development content[/b].

We tried everything we could to recover it, but in the end, we had to face a hard truth:
[b]some of the lost content cannot be fixed in a short time and must be rebuilt from scratch[/b].

For a tiny team of just two people, this has been a pretty devastating setback.
But what hurts even more is knowing that many of you have already been waiting so patiently for so long. Your support, encouragement, and feedback have helped us make it this far—and we are incredibly grateful for that.

We’re truly, truly, deeply sorry.
And we’re also here to ask: please bear with us just a little longer.

We’ll rebuild what was lost, fix the bugs, and polish everything again until the game is stable and ready. We're fully focused now on recovery and repair, and we’ll work hard to confirm a new release date as soon as we can.
Once it’s set, you’ll be the first to know.

Thank you again to everyone who’s still with us and willing to wait.
Please give us a little more time—we promise to bring back a more complete Dino Ramen Express soon!

notes.title: 🍜It's official! Dino Ramen Express launches in Early Access on July 28!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, long time no see—Wani~!

We're finally ready to share something really important to us:

[h3][b]Dino Ramen Express will launch in Early Access on Steam this July 28![/b][/h3]

This is our first ever game—something two little dinos have spent over five years building, learning, and growing along the way.

To be honest, some parts may still feel a little rough. You might run into bugs, hiccups, glitches... or even wonder if some features need more polish. But we still really wanted to share it with you early, because—
[b]it’s already packed with so many features and ideas we’re excited to show you![/b] Wani~!

In this game, you and your dino buddy will work together to build the ultimate ramen chain in Ark Park—starting from nothing and growing into a ramen empire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021196/746ba36e15cf650e4c0efa84c8f4eab1fb8cae46.png[/img]

[h2][b]🎮 So what can you do in Dino Ramen Express?[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]● Manage your ramen shop… while adventuring:[/b][/h3]
Start with a single steaming bowl of ramen, and [b]unlock new recipes[/b], [b]gather ingredients, farm, deliver orders, hire staff, and invest[/b] in your growing food empire! Make “Ramen Dragon” a household name across the land!

[h3][b]● Explore a giant open world:[/b][/h3]
The main island spans [b]around 16 square kilometers[/b] (not including underground areas!) with diverse terrain and ecosystems—snowy mountains, deserts, and more. Collect unique ingredients like cacti and coconuts!

You’ll also explore [b]38+ different zones[/b] packed with [b]dozens of exploration quests[/b], with many hidden secrets waiting to be uncovered.

[h3][b]● Delivery system:[/b][/h3]
Deliveries in this world are no joke—[b]upgrade your vehicle[/b] and race through wild terrain to deliver delicious ramen and goods to hungry customers. Let food connect communities across the world!

[h3][b]● Shooting system (PVP & PVE):[/b][/h3]
Combat plays a big role in Dino Ramen Express. Deliveries can be dangerous, and protecting your precious ramen is serious business. The game [b]supports online multiplayer battles[/b].

The Early Access version includes:
[b]15 PVE maps, 5 PVP maps, 55 launchers, 25 weapon skins, and 17 melee weapons[/b] to play with!

[h2][b]🧩Why Early Access?[/b][/h2]

We struggled with this decision for a long time.

Right now, Dino Ramen Express already features a wide range of systems—[b]ramen management, racing, PVP/PVE combat, open-world exploration[/b]—and from a “can you play it?” standpoint, it’s relatively complete.

But when it comes to “is it fun enough?”, “what's missing?”, we realized what we need most is:
[b]your voice.[/b]

We don’t want to build this in a vacuum.
We don’t want to wait until everything’s “done” to start making changes.
Instead of polishing alone, we’d rather show it to you early and grow together, step by step.

Since the game is set in a vast open world, we also hope that Early Access will help us [b]test and optimize performance and system data at scale[/b]—to deliver a smoother and better experience over time.

That said, there will still be challenges: optimization is ongoing, feature connections are still being improved, and yes, the usual suspects like bugs or visual glitches may pop up.
But even if it's a bit rough around the edges, we really want to meet you now.

We promise to listen carefully to every bit of feedback, and to keep improving the game as we go. Thank you so much for being part of this ride with us. Wani~!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2480100/_/

We're currently doing final checks to make sure we deliver the best version we can on launch day.
To everyone who’s supported us along the way—your encouragement is the reason we’ve made it this far. Thank you, truly.

We can’t wait to meet you in Ark Park!
(And please go easy on the little dinos during multiplayer, Wani~!)

notes.title: The road ahead for Dino Ramen Express: updates, feedback and next steps!
notes.content:
Hello, friends who follow "Dino Ramen Express"! Long time no see!

The bell of the New Product Festival is about to ring, First of all, please allow us to bow deeply to everyone

[h2][b]Thank you for accompanying Dino Ramen Express through this bumpy and bumpy Steam New Product Festival test! [/b][/h2]

The demo will remain available for play! If you encounter any bugs, issues, or have suggestions during your gameplay, feel free to reach out to us on Discord anytime!

As a two-dino development team, [u][b]Dino Ramen Express is our first game[/b][/u], and this test is also our first public test. This test has made us fully aware that there are still many shortcomings in the game.

There are also many issues that require careful adjustments and refinements. This ‘delivery journey’ hasn't quite lived up to expectations for our friends.

[u][b]Bugs such as crashes, freezes, black screens, and even "children's full set of Oreo limited edition mecha skins"[/b][/u] during the testing process all made us feel deeply guilty. But every time we receive heartfelt encouragement from everyone, we feel the seriousness and expectations of our friends.

[b]Really, thank you all for your understanding, encouragement, and even criticism. [/b]We will continue to work on fixing issues based on your feedback. We look forward to the next time we meet, hoping to bring you a more complete and enjoyable gaming experience!
[list]
[*][b][h2]Next time we meet, we will also bring along these new updates:[/h2][/b]
[/list]
Currently, we have prioritized all the feedback issues and are working hard to fix them.

Once the basic stability optimizations are complete, we will fully focus on the development of new content based on the optimization suggestions everyone has previously provided. 

From the [u][b]main island construction, creative workshop, multiplayer, to storyline expansion[/b][/u], we will gradually implement these features into the official version:

[h3][b]Main Island will expand both content and gameplay:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Expand Ark Paradise: [/b]Players can unlock new ramen stores in five major areas: desert, Gobi, village, small town, and city. Becoming a ramen tycoon is no longer a dream, yay!
[*] [b]Optimize the recruitment system and offer more positions for employees: [/b]delivery drivers, couriers, and security guards.
[*] [b]New Features:[/b] Farming and hunting functions. The loot obtained will be directly used in the ramen store menu. Now, a bowl of delicious ramen truly starts with the freshest ingredients! [b]Mining features will also be optimized[/b].
[*] [b]Vehicles: [/b]Add new vehicle types and vehicle customization. Now you can paint your car, add accessories, and enhance its functional attributes!
[*] [b]Building Mode: [/b]Add more types of furniture.
[*] [b]Delivery System: [/b]In addition to optimizing order generation and delivery logic, we will also add tasks or unlock random events during deliveries.
[*] [b]New Creatures: [/b]We will optimize the scene residents, add various interactive NPCs, introduce new enemy factions, and add monsters and outdoor bosses.
[/list]
[h3][b]New Creative Workshop[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Support for Mecha Customization:[/b]From modifications, skins, types, to skills. 
[*]  [b]Open Gun Customization: [/b]From spray painting colors to modding accessories, we support players in creating and sharing mods!
[*] [b]Map Editor: [/b]We’ve added a map editor! You can customize maps, gameplay, and weapons, support multiplayer participation in construction, and preset various templates.
[/list]
[h3][b]Multiplayer games: Prioritize optimizing the stability of multiplayer games![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Main Island will support 2-4 players for multiplayer. Experience an immersive "Overcooked" style gameplay!
[*] PVP, PVE Modes: New maps, gameplay, and weapon rewards will be added.
[/list]
[h3][b]Storyline: A more complete narrative![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We will reset the [b]original 5-chapter prologue[/b] and provide a more intuitive tutorial and gameplay guidance.
[*] Added [b]1 new main storyline[/b] to expand the main island gameplay.
[/list]

We recognize that Dino Ramen Express is still a long way from being fully polished and ready for everyone. Thank you again for your attention and understanding!

We will also regularly release game fix updates, developer logs, and previews of new content in the future! If you encounter [b]problems, bugs, suggestions or feedback during the testing process[/b], please feel free to [b]contact us via Discord[/b]~

We look forward to meeting everyone next time with a more complete Dino Ramen Express!

notes.title: Demo is Live! Help Our Little Dino Out, Gamers! 🦖✨
notes.content:
Dear friends who are keeping an eye on Dino Ramen Expres,
It's finally here—our first public Demo is live, just in time for the Steam Next Fest! 🎉 
We’re so excited to officially show you a sneak peek of what we’ve been working on!

At the start, we envisioned a wild adventure in an open world, delivering delicious ramen to different universes! And as we fleshed it out, we added some of our favorite themes—shooting, wild driving, multiplayer co-op, and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021196/ca2d0b12afff983789aeac41e79ed0e29c14fdbe.gif[/img]
But, as with any game development journey, we’ve hit some bumps along the way. Thankfully, your support has been a huge help! Before the Chinese New Year, we ran a small test, and we received so much encouragement and valuable feedback. This gave us the confidence to participate in the Steam Next Fest!

That said, the current version is still very much a work in progress. You might encounter some “surprises”: lag, clipping issues, random bugs, or maybe even some strange glitches. But don’t worry—we’re ready to tackle them, and we need your help to spot these little problems! Whether it's stuttering, falling through the world, or something that doesn’t quite make sense, please let us know! 

Every piece of feedback is precious, and we’ll jump on it ASAP! m(_ _)m 

[h2]And we’d also love to hear about your experience playing! It’ll be invaluable for us as we move forward![/h2]

For this Demo, we’ve included [b]5 prologue chapters[/b], [b]a multiplayer mode (PVP and PVE, with 13 different maps)[/b], and [b]40+ weapons [/b]for you to try out. 

The chance to let everyone try out the game is super important to us, so we’ve packed in as many different features as we could. That said, the gameplay might not be super deep yet, but[b] we hope it’ll give you a feel for the different modes and mechanics. We’d love to hear what you think![/b]

Here’s a breakdown of the Demo content:
[list]
[*] [b]Prologue[/b]:The 5 prologue chapters set up the game’s story and give you a chance to familiarize yourself with basic controls (like changing outfits, unlocking things, and getting a feel for different weapons). 

[*] [b]40+ Weapons to Try[/b]:We’ve packed 40+ weapons into the Demo, and you’ll be able to get your hands on them through various means. Please share your thoughts on how each weapon feels—it’s super important for us! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021196/62a41ff383791ca27b18c5a71e5426b5a6de1e4c.png[/img]

[*] [b]Multiplayer Mode[/b]:The multiplayer mode is divided [b]into PVE and PVP[/b], each with its own unique maps. We’re giving you [b]7 PVE maps and 6 PVP maps [/b]to check out. Let us know what you think about the designs, style, and scenery! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021196/b57b2c8c7d260e4b6b0843f60fce6b6b1a2b9ff4.png[/img]

[*] [b]Main Island[/b]: After finishing the prologue, you’ll be able to explore the main island. You can interact with various elements here. We also wanted to show you some of the island-building gameplay, [u]but we didn’t quite manage to finish it in time, so we’ll update it in the next few days.[/u] For now, you can start collecting materials! This part of the Demo will also be updated continuously！
[/list]

We’re all set to fully support the first public playthrough of the game! We’ll be active in the community, chatting with you about your experiences and feedback. If you run into any issues or bugs, we’ll be there to monitor them and fix them as quickly as we can.

[h2][b]We highly recommend joining the Discord for real-time interaction and report issues with us! We’ll try to reply as quickly as possible![/b][/h2]

Honestly, writing this is making me a little emotional. We’re so eager to connect with all of you, and I just want to say a huge thank you to everyone who’s been supporting us. Every time we hit a rough patch in development, it’s your kind advice and encouragement that gives us the direction and confidence to keep going.

Wishing you the best in becoming a hero—or owning a ramen shop that makes you happy. 🍜💖

— Anti Game
